requirements.requirement: The synthetic RAW -> STAGE -> MART pipeline must produce a QoQ revenue growth number whose MART total reconciles exactly against the contract-defined RAW completed-order revenue total (no cancelled-order leakage, no double counting), per docs/autonomous_execution/pilot_fixtures/analytics/DATA_CONTRACT.md metric_rules and validation_checks.
requirements.source: docs/pilots/AES_ANALYTICS_PILOT.md (Phase 4 task) + orchestrator task instructions for this pilot run

defects.description: build_mart() in scripts/pilot_analytics_build_mart.py omitted the status == 'completed' filter required by DATA_CONTRACT.md metric_rules, so cancelled-order revenue_usd leaked into the MART aggregation. Observed: mart_total_revenue_usd = 2440.00 vs. contract_expected_revenue_usd (RAW, completed-only) = 2130.00; QoQ growth_pct reported as 19.82 instead of the correct 24.21. Reconciliation checks stage_completed_revenue_equals_mart_total_revenue, contract_expected_revenue_equals_mart_total_revenue, and mart_units_equal_raw_completed_units_no_double_counting all failed.
